title.zh: CFTC 发布代币化资产与区块链记录新指引
title.en: CFTC Issues Guidance on Tokenized Assets and Blockchain Records

current_state.zh: The CFTC updated its guidance for registered crypto entities to allow customer funds to be invested in tokenized assets with equivalent legal rights and to permit blockchain-based recordkeeping, framed as providing regulatory clarity after a failed CLARITY Act vote.
current_state.en: The CFTC updated its guidance for registered crypto entities to allow customer funds to be invested in tokenized assets with equivalent legal rights and to permit blockchain-based recordkeeping, framed as providing regulatory clarity after a failed CLARITY Act vote.

updates.title_zh: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
updates.title_en: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
updates.what_changed_zh: The CFTC has issued further guidance affirming that U.S. commodities and derivatives firms can invest in tokenized assets and use blockchain records for compliance, signaling continued regulatory openness to tokenization.
